snippet.title: 누가 육개장 어렵데요??
snippet.description:
📌 재료
소고기양지600g
무
대파
마늘
고사리
버섯
콩나물

📌 양념
다진마늘3T,국간장3T,참치액1T,다시다1T,고춧가루4T,참기름2T,후추,소금약간

📌 만드는 방법
1.소고기 양지는 1시간 정도 핏물 빼기
2.냄비에 물 넉넉히 넣고 대파,마늘,무와 함께 1시간 푹 끓여 육수 만들기
3.끓는 동안 올라오는 거품은 깔끔하게 제거하기
4.삶은 고기는 찢거나 먹기 좋게 썰기
5.고기에 양념 넣고 조물조물 버무리기
6.육수에 고사리,버섯 넣고 끓이다가 콩나물,대파,양념고기 넣고 15분 끓이기
7.마지막 소금으로 간 맞추면 완성

💡 꿀팁
-콩나물은 듬뿍 넣어야 국물이 훨씬 시원해집니다
-참기름 넣고 고기 양념해주면 육개장 특유의 깊은 풍미가 살아나요
-약불로 오래 끓일수록 국물이 훨씬 진해집니다

마늘
고사리

📌 양념
다진마늘3T,국간장3T,참치액1T,다시다1T,고춧가루4T,참기름2T,후추,소금약간

📌 만드는 방법
1.소고기 양지는 1시간 정도 핏물 빼기
2.냄비에 물 넉넉히 넣고 대파,마늘,무와 함께 1시간 푹 끓여 육수 만들기

4.삶은 고기는 찢거나 먹기 좋게 썰기
5.고기에 양념 넣고 조물조물 버무리기
6.육수에 고사리,버섯 넣고 끓이다가 콩나물,대파,양념고기 넣고 15분 끓이기
7.마지막 소금으로 간 맞추면 완성

-콩나물은 듬뿍 넣어야 국물이 훨씬 시원해집니다

-약불로 오래 끓일수록 국물이 훨씬 진해집니다

snippet.description:

📌 재료
소고기양지600g
무
대파
마늘
고사리
버섯
콩나물

📌 양념
다진마늘3T,국간장3T,참치액1T,다시다1T,고춧가루4T,참기름2T,후추,소금약간

📌 만드는 방법
1.소고기 양지는 1시간 정도 핏물 빼기
2.냄비에 물 넉넉히 넣고 대파,마늘,무와 함께 1시간 푹 끓여 육수 만들기
3.끓는 동안 올라오는 거품은 깔끔하게 제거하기
4.삶은 고기는 찢거나 먹기 좋게 썰기
5.고기에 양념 넣고 조물조물 버무리기
6.육수에 고사리,버섯 넣고 끓이다가 콩나물,대파,양념고기 넣고 15분 끓이기
7.마지막 소금으로 간 맞추면 완성

-콩나물은 듬뿍 넣어야 국물이 훨씬 시원해집니다
-참기름 넣고 고기 양념해주면 육개장 특유의 깊은 풍미가 살아나요

id.title: Siapa bilang Yukgaejang itu sulit? Jika dimasak seperti ini, rasanya luar biasa.
id.description:
Hari ini, saya mencoba membuat yukgaejang daging sapi dan tauge yang mudah dibuat di rumah. Ini adalah yukgaejang yang sangat saya rekomendasikan 😁

📌 Bahan-bahan

600g Daging Sandung Lamur Sapi

Lobak

Daun Bawang

Bawang Putih

Pakis

Jamur

Tabu

📌 Bumbu

3 sdm Bawang Putih Cincang, 3 sdm Kecap Asin, 1 sdm Ekstrak Tuna, 1 sdm Dashida (Dashida Jepang), 4 sdm Bubuk Cabai Merah, 2 sdm Minyak Wijen, Merica, sejumput Garam

📌 Cara Membuat

1. Rendam daging sandung lamur sapi untuk menghilangkan darah selama kurang lebih 1 jam.

2. Masukkan banyak air ke dalam panci dan didihkan dengan daun bawang, bawang putih, dan lobak selama 1 jam untuk membuat kaldu.

3. Buang busa yang muncul di permukaan saat mendidih.

4. Iris atau potong daging rebus menjadi potongan-potongan kecil seukuran gigitan.

5. Tambahkan bumbu ke daging dan aduk rata.

6. Tambahkan pakis dan jamur ke dalam kaldu dan didihkan. Kemudian tambahkan tauge, daun bawang, dan daging yang sudah dibumbui, lalu masak dengan api kecil selama 15 menit.

7. Terakhir, sesuaikan bumbu dengan garam untuk penyelesaian.

💡 Tips

- Gunakan banyak tauge. Menambahkan ini membuat kaldu jauh lebih menyegarkan.

- Menambahkan minyak wijen dan membumbui daging akan mengeluarkan rasa Yukgaejang yang dalam dan khas.

- Semakin lama dimasak dengan api kecil, semakin kaya rasa kaldunya.

en-US.title: Who says Yukgaejang is difficult? If you cook it like this, it's killer.
en-US.description:
Today, I tried making a proper beef and bean sprout yukgaejang that is easy to prepare at home. This is a Yukgaejang I highly recommend 😁

📌 Ingredients

600g Beef Brisket

Radish

Green Onion

Garlic

Bracken

Mushroom

Bean Sprouts

📌 Seasoning

3T Minced Garlic, 3T Soup Soy Sauce, 1T Tuna Extract, 1T Dashida (Japanese Dashida), 4T Red Pepper Powder, 2T Sesame Oil, Pepper, a pinch of Salt

📌 Instructions

1. Soak the beef brisket to remove blood for about 1 hour.

2. Put plenty of water in a pot and simmer thoroughly with green onion, garlic, and radish for 1 hour to make the broth.

3. Neatly remove any foam that rises to the surface while boiling.

4. Shred or cut the boiled meat into bite-sized pieces.

5. Add the seasoning to the meat and mix well.

6. Add the bracken and mushrooms to the broth and bring to a boil. Then add the bean sprouts, green onion, and seasoned meat and simmer for 15 minutes.

7. Finally, adjust the seasoning with salt to finish.

💡 Tip

- Use plenty of bean sprouts Adding this makes the broth much more refreshing.

- Adding sesame oil and seasoning the meat brings out the deep, distinctive flavor of Yukgaejang.

- The longer you simmer it over low heat, the richer the broth becomes.

en-US.title: A recipe for medicinal seaweed soup, a true restorative dish
en-US.description:
💥 How to Make

1. Remove the blood from 3kg of beef back ribs and blanch them in boiling water for about 5 minutes.

2. Place the thoroughly washed ribs into a pressure cooker along with rice wine, green onions, whole peppercorns, garlic, and onions, and cook for about 35 to 40 minutes.

3. Remove the ribs, separate the meat from the bones, and skim off the fat floating on the broth.

4. Add more water to the broth and boil for about 20 minutes with the soaked seaweed.

5. Season with 5 tablespoons of perilla seed powder, 3 tablespoons of soup soy sauce, pepper, and salt. Add the prepared rib meat and bring to a boil once more to finish.

id.title: Resep sup rumput laut berkhasiat, hidangan yang benar-benar menyehatkan.
id.description:
💥 Cara Membuat

1. Buang darah dari 3 kg iga sapi dan rebus sebentar dalam air mendidih selama sekitar 5 menit.

2. Masukkan iga yang sudah dicuci bersih ke dalam panci presto bersama dengan arak beras, daun bawang, merica utuh, bawang putih, dan bawang bombai, lalu masak selama sekitar 35 hingga 40 menit.

3. Angkat iga, pisahkan daging dari tulang, dan buang lemak yang mengapung di atas kaldu.

4. Tambahkan air ke dalam kaldu dan rebus selama sekitar 20 menit dengan rumput laut yang sudah direndam.

5. Bumbui dengan 5 sendok makan bubuk biji perilla, 3 sendok makan kecap asin, merica, dan garam. Tambahkan daging iga yang sudah disiapkan dan didihkan kembali hingga matang.

snippet.title: 황태국에 이거 하나 했더니 국물이 달라졌습니다
snippet.description:
황태국에 이거 하나 했더니 국물이 달라졌습니다
🍳 재료
황태채100g,무,대파,두부

🥣 양념
들기름3~4T,마늘0.5T,다시다0.5T,소금,후추

👨‍🍳 만드는법
황태채 물에 헹궈 준비
들기름 넣고 황태 먼저 볶기
무 넣고 물 살짝 잠길 정도만 넣기

en-US.title: I added this to the dried pollack soup and the broth turned out completely different.
en-US.description:
I just added this one ingredient to my dried pollack soup, and the broth turned out completely different.

🍳 Ingredients

100g dried pollack strips, radish, green onion, tofu

🥣 Seasoning

3~4 tbsp perilla oil, 0.5 tbsp garlic, 0.5 tbsp dashida (Japanese dashi), salt, pepper

👨‍🍳 Instructions

Rinse the dried pollack strips in water and prepare.

Add perilla oil and stir-fry the pollack first.

Add the radish and add just enough water to slightly cover it.

Boil over high heat for 10 minutes.

Add 1.5L of water and green onion, then boil for another 10 minutes.

Season with tofu, garlic, dashida, salt, and pepper.

💡 Key Points

✔ Stir-fry the pollack in perilla oil first for a deep flavor.

✔ Use less water initially to extract a rich flavor.

✔ Boil over high heat to make the broth milky white.

en-US.title: It turned out completely different after adding tomatoes. Making a really delicious rolled omelet.
en-US.description:
🥘 Measured Recipe (Serves 2-3)

4-5 eggs, a pinch of salt

1 tomato, a little green onion

Appropriate amount of mozzarella cheese

1 tablespoon cooking oil

🔥 Key Steps

Beat the eggs and add a pinch of salt.

Sauté the green onion first to make green onion oil.

Add the tomato and sauté until the moisture evaporates (Key point).

Wipe the pan and add a little oil again.

Spread the egg thinly → Add tomato and cheese.

Repeat folding, pouring, and folding (3-4 times).

Cook slowly over low heat.

💡 Pro Tip (This makes a huge difference)

✔ You need to evaporate the tomato moisture to concentrate the flavor.

✔ If the heat is too high, the egg will crack → Always use low heat.

✔ The “filling” is key, not the shape.

👉 The “tomato + cheese combination” is 90% of the taste.

🥘 계량 레시피 (2인 기준)
토마토10개,계란3~4개,마늘0.5T,식용유2T
대패삼겹살100~150g(생략가능)
간장1T,굴소스0.5T,치킨스톡0.5T,고춧가루2T
물500ml,대파,참기름

🔥 만드는 순서 핵심
기름2T+마늘0.5T 볶기
토마토 넣고 충분히 볶기
고기 넣고 익히기
간장1T,굴소스0.5T,치킨스톡0.5T,고춧가루2T
물500ml 넣고 끓이기
계란 풀고 절대 휘젓지 말기 (중요)
파 + 참기름 한바퀴
💡 꿀팁 (진짜 중요)

✔ 토마토 많이 넣을수록 맛 올라감
✔ 계란 넣고 휘젓지 않기 → 비주얼 + 식감 차이
✔ 고기 없으면 채소 넣어도 충분히 맛있음

en-US.title: This is all you need… The Tomato Egg Soup that everyone is raving about for being tastier than ramen
en-US.description:
🥘 Measured Recipe (Serves 2)

10 tomatoes, 3-4 eggs, 0.5T garlic, 2T cooking oil

100-150g thinly sliced ​​pork belly (optional)

1T soy sauce, 0.5T oyster sauce, 0.5T chicken stock, 2T red chili powder

500ml water, green onions, sesame oil

🔥 Key Instructions

Sauté 2T oil + 0.5T garlic

Add tomatoes and sauté thoroughly

Add meat and cook until done

1T soy sauce, 0.5T oyster sauce, 0.5T chicken stock, 2T red chili powder

Add 500ml water and bring to a boil

Beat the eggs but do not stir (Important)

Green onions + a drizzle of sesame oil

💡 Pro Tips (Really Important)

✔ The more tomatoes you add, the better the flavor

✔ Do not stir after adding eggs → Makes a difference in visual appeal + texture

✔ If you don't have meat, adding vegetables is sufficient Delicious

snippet.title: 초록색 피자 만들기
snippet.description:
참나물 페스토를 만들어
건강하고 맛있는 피자를 완성시켰어요
상상 이상의 맛으로 정말 기분좋게 먹었습니다
특별한 피자 드시고 싶다면 꼭 만들어 보세요~~ 😁

🧾 계량 레시피
✔ 참나물 페스토

참나물30g,견과류한줌,파마산치즈3T,마늘3알,소금약간,후추약간,올리브오일6T,들기름약간

👉 전부 넣고 갈아주면 끝

✔ 피자 만들기

피자도우(또띠아 가능),모짜렐라치즈,방울토마토,참나물

도우 위에 페스토 듬뿍
치즈 넉넉하게
토마토 + 참나물 올리기
오븐220도7~8분 / 에어프라이어180도7~8분

👉 전자레인지 4~5분도 가능 (초간단🔥)
💡 꿀팁 (이거 모르면 맛 반토막)
치즈는 파지 제품 쓰면 가성비 미쳤습니다
페스토는 오일 부족하면 무조건 추가 (안 갈림⚠️)
마지막에 생 참나물 한 번 더 올리면 향 2배
꿀 찍어먹으면 → 단짠 조합 완성

en-US.title: Making a green pizza
en-US.description:
I made Chamnamul pesto

and completed a healthy and delicious pizza.

It tasted beyond my imagination, and I really enjoyed eating it.

If you want to try a special pizza, be sure to try making this~~ 😁

🧾 Recipe by Measurement

✔ Chamnamul Pesto

30g Chamnamul, a handful of nuts, 3T Parmesan cheese, 3 cloves of garlic, a pinch of salt, a pinch of pepper, 6T olive oil, a little perilla oil

👉 Just put everything in and blend, and you're done.

✔ Making Pizza

Pizza dough (tortilla is also fine), mozzarella cheese, cherry tomatoes, Chamnamul

Spread plenty of pesto on the dough

Spread plenty of cheese

Add tomatoes + Chamnamul

Oven 220°C for 7-8 minutes / Air fryer 180°C for 7-8 minutes

👉 Microwave 4-5 minutes is also possible (Super simple🔥)

💡 Pro Tip (If you don't know this, the taste is cut in half)

If you use Paji cheese, the cost-effectiveness is insane

Pesto is oil If it's not enough, always add more (It won't be ground⚠️)

Adding fresh Korean aster greens one more time at the end doubles the aroma

Dipping in honey → The perfect sweet and salty combination

en-US.title: The secret to the perfect Dakgalbi marinade with just this sauce!!
en-US.description:
📝 Ingredients (Serves 2)

500g chicken thigh meat, plenty of cabbage, 1 sweet potato, green onion, perilla leaves, udon noodles, mozzarella cheese

[Sauce]

10 cloves of garlic, 1 onion, a little green onion, 3T soy sauce, mirin or rice wine, 2T sugar, 5T red chili powder, 2T sesame oil, 0.25T black pepper, 1T gochujang

1T curry powder, 1T chicken stock, 10-15 Vietnamese chili peppers

🍳 Instructions

Mix all the sauce ingredients together to make the sauce.

Cut the chicken thigh meat into bite-sized pieces and marinate with only half of the sauce.

Sauté the sweet potato and cabbage first to evaporate moisture (this is the key).

Sauté the chicken separately, then add the vegetables.

Taste and add the remaining sauce.

Finally, add the perilla leaves and green onion to finish.

Add udon noodles and melt the cheese on top to complete.

💡 Pro Tips (This One Tip Makes the Difference)

✔ Stir-fry the vegetables first to evaporate the water for a “restaurant-quality” taste

✔ 1 spoonful of curry powder → Removes unwanted odors + enhances flavor

✔ Chicken stock → The key to an explosion of chicken flavor

✔ Using a wide pan guarantees a better taste

I will not play games with food.

I make everything with the standard that my own family will be eating it.

snippet.title: 집에서 이렇게 하면 닭갈비집 안 갑니다 닭갈비 비법 레시피
snippet.description:
물 없이 볶는 철판 느낌 닭갈비 집에서 이 정도 나오면 그냥 끝이에요

📝 재료 (2인 기준)
닭다리살500g,양배추넉넉히,고구마1개,대파,깻잎,우동사리,모짜렐라치즈

[양념장]
마늘10알,양파1개,대파약간,간장3T,미림또는청주,설탕2T,고춧가루5T,참기름2T,후추0.25T,고추장1T
카레가루1T,치킨스톡1T,베트남고추10~15개

🍳 만드는 방법
양념 재료 전부 넣고 갈아서 소스 만들기
닭다리살 한입 크기로 썰어 양념 절반만 넣어 재우기
고구마,양배추 먼저 볶아서 수분 날리기 (이게 핵심)
닭고기 따로 볶다가 채소 합치기
간 보고 남은 양념 추가
마지막에 깻잎,대파 넣고 마무리
우동사리 + 치즈 올려서 녹이면 완성
💡 꿀팁 (이거 하나로 맛 갈림)

✔ 채소 먼저 볶아서 물 날리면 “식당 맛” 나옵니다
✔ 카레가루 1스푼 → 잡내 제거 + 풍미 상승
✔ 치킨스톡 → 닭맛 폭발 포인트
✔ 넓은 팬 쓰면 무조건 맛 올라갑니다

🧠 한 줄 핵심
“물 없이 볶으면 사먹는 닭갈비 됩니다”

📦 추가 포인트
✔ 치킨 대신 먹어도 만족감 높음
✔ 아이, 어른 다 좋아하는 메뉴
✔ 마지막에 볶음밥까지 가면 끝

🏷 해시태그

en-US.title: If you do this at home, you won't have to go to a Dakgalbi restaurant. Secret Dakgalbi Recipe
en-US.description:
If a restaurant serving this kind of stir-fried chicken galbi without water, it’s simply amazing.

📝 Ingredients (Serves 2)

500g chicken thigh meat, plenty of cabbage, 1 sweet potato, green onion, perilla leaves, udon noodles, mozzarella cheese

[Sauce]

10 cloves of garlic, 1 onion, a little green onion, 3T soy sauce, mirin or rice wine, 2T sugar, 5T red chili powder, 2T sesame oil, 0.25T black pepper, 1T gochujang

1T curry powder, 1T chicken stock, 10-15 Vietnamese chili peppers

🍳 Instructions

Put all the seasoning ingredients in a blender and blend to make the sauce.

Cut the chicken thigh meat into bite-sized pieces and marinate with only half of the sauce.

Stir-fry the sweet potato and cabbage first to evaporate the moisture (this is the key).

Stir-fry the chicken separately, then add the vegetables.

Taste and add the remaining sauce.

Finally, add the perilla leaves and green onion. Add ingredients and finish

Add Udon noodles and top with cheese to melt, then it's done

💡 Big Tip (This one thing makes all the difference)

✔ Stir-fry the vegetables first to evaporate the water for a “restaurant-quality taste”

✔ 1 spoonful of curry powder → Removes unwanted odors + enhances flavor

✔ Chicken stock → The key to an explosion of chicken flavor

✔ Using a wide pan guarantees a great taste

🧠 Key Point

“Stir-frying without water makes it store-bought Dakgalbi”

📦 Additional Points

✔ Highly satisfying even as a substitute for fried chicken

✔ A dish loved by both kids and adults

✔ Finish off with fried rice at the end

🏷 Hashtags

#DakgalbiRecipe #HomeCookingRecipe #IronPlateDakgalbi #SimpleCooking #DakgalbiAtHome #CookingVideo

snippet.description:
🔥재료(5~6인분)
미역 60g
소고기 200g
밥 한공기

en-US.title: I added this when making seaweed soup... Wow, it really was the secret ingredient.
en-US.description:
🔥Ingredients (5-6 servings)

60g seaweed

200g beef

1 bowl of rice

1. Soak the seaweed in water for 15 minutes, then cut it into pieces about the size of a finger joint.

2. Gently knead the seaweed with your hands to soften it.

3. Put the seaweed, beef, 3 tablespoons of soup soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon of fish sauce into a large pot.

4. Add just two or three cups of water, enough to slightly cover the ingredients, and bring to a boil.

5. Close the lid and boil vigorously over high heat for just 10 minutes.

6. Afterwards, pour in more water to fill the pot and add one bowl of rice.

en-US.description:
📝 Tofu Ssamjang Recipe

Cabbage

1T Soy Sauce, 2T Perilla Oil

Tofu Ssamjang

3T Doenjang, 2T Gochujang, minced tofu, minced onion, minced garlic, 2T Red Pepper Powder, 2T Allulose, 2T Perilla Oil, 2T Sesame Seeds

💥 Add Spicy Chopped Anchovies & Chili Peppers

✔ A real lifesaver on busy days when you don't have any side dishes

✔ A versatile item that works with rice, wraps, bibimbap, and stir-fries

🍳 How to Make

Cut the cabbage into large pieces, add soy sauce and perilla oil, and microwave for 6 minutes

Mash half a block of tofu and completely remove the moisture

Add all the seasonings and mix

Finally, add the chopped anchovies & chili peppers to finish

💡 Tips / Know-how

✔ Removing moisture from the tofu is key (if not squeezed, it will be mushy)

✔ Microwave cabbage Cooking → Captures both sweetness and texture

✔ Levels up from "Side Dish" to "Rice Thief" the moment minced chili is added

id.title: Resep Tahu Ssamjang Pencuri Kubis
id.description:
📝 Resep Tahu Ssamjang

Kubis

1 sdm Kecap Asin, 2 sdm Minyak Perilla

Tahu Ssamjang

3 sdm Doenjang, 2 sdm Gochujang, tahu cincang, bawang bombai cincang, bawang putih cincang, 2 sdm Bubuk Cabai Merah, 2 sdm Allulose, 2 sdm Minyak Perilla, 2 sdm Biji Wijen

💥 Tambahkan Ikan Teri Cincang Pedas & Cabai Rawit

✔ Cabai Rawit Cincang Pedas → Cukup tambahkan untuk melengkapi rasa umami

✔ Penyelamat sejati di hari-hari sibuk ketika Anda tidak memiliki lauk piring

✔ Hidangan serbaguna yang cocok dengan nasi, wrap, bibimbap, dan tumisan

🍳 Cara Membuat

Potong kubis menjadi potongan besar, tambahkan kecap asin dan minyak perilla, lalu masak dalam microwave selama 6 menit

Hancurkan setengah blok tahu dan buang semua airnya

Tambahkan semua bumbu dan Campur semua bahan.

Terakhir, tambahkan ikan teri cincang dan cabai untuk sentuhan akhir.

💡 Tips / Cara Memasak

✔ Menghilangkan kelembapan dari tahu sangat penting (jika tidak diperas, tahu akan lembek)

✔ Memasak kubis dengan microwave → Mempertahankan rasa manis dan tekstur yang baik

✔ Dari sekadar lauk, berubah menjadi hidangan utama saat cabai cincang ditambahkan

en-US.title: Say goodbye to diet worries: A ssamjang recipe that makes cabbage 10 times tastier
en-US.description:
Eating cabbage plain is a bit boring, isn't it?

With just this one… I can't stop eating rice

📝 Tofu Ssamjang Recipe

Cabbage

1T Soy Sauce, 2T Perilla Oil

Tofu Ssamjang

3T Doenjang, 2T Gochujang, minced tofu, minced onion, minced garlic, 2T Red Pepper Powder, 2T Allulose, 2T Perilla Oil, 2T Sesame Seeds

💥 Add Spicy Chopped Anchovies & Chili Peppers

✔ Spicy Chopped Chili Peppers → Just add them to complete the umami flavor

✔ A real lifesaver on busy days when you don't have any side dishes

✔ A versatile item that works with rice, wraps, bibimbap, and stir-fries

🍳 How to Make

Cut the cabbage into large pieces, add soy sauce and perilla oil, and microwave for 6 minutes

Mash half a block of tofu and completely remove the moisture

Add all the seasonings and mix

Finally, add the chopped anchovies & chili peppers to finish

💡 Tips / Know-how

✔ Removing the moisture from the tofu is key (if not squeezed, it will be mushy)

✔ Microwave-cooked Cabbage → Captures both sweetness and texture

✔ Levels up from "Side Dish" to "Rice Thief" the moment minced chili is added

📌 Measured Recipe (2-3 servings)

Water 100ml

Soy Sauce 5T

Mirin 1T

Tuna Extract 0.5T

Sesame Oil 0.5T

Pepper

5-6 Eggs

A little Green Onion

✔ Cooking Method

Mix the seasoning base first.

Add the eggs as is, without whisking.

Shake gently to allow the seasoning to soak in.

Top with green onion.

Steam in boiling water for 5-7 minutes.

💡 Pro Tip (This one step makes all the difference in taste)

✔ Absolutely do not whisk the eggs (Key point).

✔ The timing is 80% soft-boiled for the best taste.

✔ Adding a little sugar gives it a Jangjorim (Korean braised beef) feel.

✔ Add sesame oil one more time at the end = A rice thief is complete.

🍚 How to Eat (The real key point)

Place an egg on top of warm rice.

Break the yolk.

And mix it all together, including the broth.

👉 That's it.

🧾 Recipe by Measurement

[Ingredients]

1 bunch of green onions

en-US.title: For soy sauce dakgalbi, just pay attention to this!! Guaranteed success
en-US.description:
📌 Soy Sauce Dakgalbi (Spicy Stir-fried Chicken) Meal Recipe (2-3 Servings)

600g chicken thigh meat

300-500g cabbage (generous amount)

[Blanched Cabbage]

1T salt, 1T sugar

[Chicken Marinade]

1T soy sauce, 2T oyster sauce, 1T sugar, 2T rice wine, black pepper

2T black bean sauce powder

Green onions, onions, garlic, chili peppers (optional)

🍳 Cooking Method

Slice the cabbage first,

Add 1T salt and 1T sugar and let it marinate.

When water comes out, rinse lightly,

👉 Squeeze out the water “tightly” (Key point)

Add the marinade + black bean sauce powder to the chicken thigh meat and mix well.

Heat oil in a pan,

Sauté the green onions and garlic first to make green onion oil.

Sauté the chicken first,

then add the cabbage and sauté together.

💡 Pro Tip (You will fail if you skip this step)

✔ Removing moisture from the cabbage is key.

✔ The black bean sauce powder prevents water from forming.

✔ Cabbage Enhances both texture and color

✔ A final drizzle of sesame oil = elevates the finish

🍚 It tastes even better this way

✔ Eat it immediately with rice

✔ Stir-fry udon noodles in the leftover sauce

✔ Finish with fried rice for the perfect result

👉 Once you make it, you'll definitely want to make it twice

id.title: Jangan kocok telur Anda lagi!! Resep emas untuk telur kukus yang luar biasa.
id.description:
Telur Rebus Kecap Asin, lebih enak jika tidak dikocok. Coba buat hari ini! 👇

📌 Resep (2-3 porsi)

Air 100ml

Kecap Asin 5t

Mirin 1t

Ekstrak Tuna 0,5t

Minyak Wijen 0,5t

Merica

5-6 Butir Telur

Sedikit daun bawang cincang

✔ Cara Memasak

Campur bumbu terlebih dahulu.

Masukkan telur apa adanya, tanpa dikocok.

Kocok perlahan agar bumbu meresap.

Taburi dengan daun bawang cincang.

Kukus dalam air mendidih selama 5-7 menit.

💡 Tips Pro (Satu hal ini membuat perbedaan besar dalam rasa)

✔ Jangan sekali-kali mengocok telur (Poin penting).

✔ Waktu memasak 80% setengah matang untuk rasa terbaik.

✔ Menambahkan sedikit gula akan memberikan rasa seperti Jangjorim (daging sapi rebus Korea).

✔ Tambahkan minyak wijen sekali lagi di akhir = Rice Thief (telur rebus) siap disajikan.

🍚 Cara Makan (Poin kunci sebenarnya)

Letakkan sebutir telur di atas nasi hangat.

Pecahkan kuning telurnya.

Dan campur semuanya, termasuk kuahnya.

👉 Ini dia... Selesai.

en-US.title: Don't whisk your eggs anymore!! The golden recipe for amazing steamed eggs
en-US.description:
Soy Sauce Poached Eggs, tastier when left unbeaten. Try making this today! 👇

📌 Recipe (2-3 servings)

Water 100ml

Soy Sauce 5T

Mirin 1T

Tuna Extract 0.5T

Sesame Oil 0.5T

Pepper

5-6 Eggs

A little chopped green onion

✔ Cooking Method

Mix the seasoning base first.

Add the eggs as is, without beating them.

Shake gently to allow the seasoning to soak in.

Top with chopped green onion.

Steam in boiling water for 5-7 minutes.

💡 Pro Tip (This one thing makes all the difference in taste)

✔ Absolutely do not beat the eggs (Key point).

✔ The timing is 80% soft-boiled for the best taste.

✔ Adding a little sugar gives it a Jangjorim (Korean braised beef) feel.

✔ Add sesame oil one more time at the end = A rice thief is complete.

🍚 How to Eat (The real key point)

Place an egg on top of warm rice.

Break the yolk.

And mix it all together, including the broth.

👉 This is just... That's it.

en-US.title: If I can get this taste at home… my plans to eat out are over. Butter Garlic Chicken Recipe
en-US.description:
Today, I tried making Butter Garlic Chicken Steak using just one chicken thigh.

🥘 Recipe by Measurement

1kg Chicken Thighs

2T Soy Sauce, 2T Rice Wine, 1T Sugar, Pepper

✔ Season and let it marinate for a while

[Sauce]

1T Butter

2~3T Minced Garlic

1T Soy Sauce

2T Ketchup

1T Honey

100ml Water

2T Parmesan Cheese

✔ Sauté butter and garlic

✔ Add sauce and bring to a boil

✔ Add cheese to finish

🔥 Tips / Know-how

Never add oil to the chicken thighs

👉 You must grill them using the oil released from the skin to bring out both crispiness and flavor

Grill the skin side first (this is the key)

→ You must wait without flipping them to get the proper color

For the garlic, always

👉 Use whole garlic that you minced yourself (the difference in aroma is huge)

When Parmesan cheese is added

👉 It's not just a sauce, it becomes a “restaurant taste”
